name: pipeline
description: Multi-agent development driven by a plan you own. An interview with the orchestrator produces the plan; three dials — complexity, ambiguity, exposure — decide how much planning, orchestration and review each item gets; you place the gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run work packages through planning, critique, build, review, retro, and ship.
interface.longDescription: Pipeline packages a structured multi-agent software delivery workflow for Codex. It provides skills for work planning, refinement, design, architecture, TDD implementation, review, documentation, retro, and shipping, with explicit pipeline-planner/pipeline-reviewer/pipeline-builder separation.
defaultPrompt: Review this change with the pipeline.
Plan a new pipeline work package.
